# SAP UI Theme Designer

Skills that teach agents to work with SAP UI Theme Designer. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [SAP/ui-theme-designer-plugins-for-coding-agents](https://github.com/SAP/ui-theme-designer-plugins-for-coding-agents), at commit `3eff583`.

Plugin for coding agents working with UI theme designer.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **SAP UI Theme Designer**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **SAP UI Theme Designer**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install ui-theme-designer@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

2 skills: `ui-theme-designer-design-tokens`, `ui-theme-designer-help`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/SAP/ui-theme-designer-plugins-for-coding-agents
